svg.title: Ways in to your DorkOS from another device
svg.desc: Four routes reach a person's own DorkOS server from elsewhere, and each is a different route: the network listener on the same network, the person's own tunnel, managed remote ingress, and the chat relay through a hub. A sign-in made on one route is refused on another. The relay carries chats only and dials the hub the computer pinned, not Cloud. The tunnel and the network listener are shipped; managed remote and the relay are built and off by default; the hub is built and not deployed.
